function: Jointly learns BS transmit beamforming, user power-splitting ratios, and STAR-RIS phase shifts and amplitudes to maximize spectral and energy efficiency in a SWIPT downlink (p. 1-3).
system: MISO: 5-antenna BS, 2/4/6 single-antenna users, simultaneously transmitting and reflecting RIS (STAR-RIS) with 4 to 81 elements, flat fading; frequency band not stated (p. 2, 4).
method: Meta-DDPG: DDPG actor-critic plus a meta-critic loss that also updates the actor; deep reinforcement learning with meta-learning, trained over episodes with a replay buffer (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Simulated flat-fading channels: Rayleigh on all links for training, Rician on the BS-user direct link for testing; no public dataset or measurement (p. 2, 5).
test_conditions: Trained with Rayleigh fading on all channels; tested with Rician fading on the direct BS-user channel (Fig. 2c, K=6); other figures vary users, power, elements (p. 5).
baselines: Learned: classic DDPG. Non-learned: genetic algorithm, exhaustive search, convex optimization benchmark; conventional reflective RIS as system comparison (p. 4-5, Figs. 2c, 3c).
metrics: Spectral efficiency (bps/Hz) and energy efficiency (bps/Joule/Hz) versus episodes, users, nu, Pmax, and number of RIS elements (p. 4-5).
complexity: FLOPS-based time-complexity analysis giving an O(...) expression in the layer sizes of actor, critic, and meta-critic networks; no runtime or parameter count (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 5: "assuming Rayleigh fading for all channels" (custom flat-fading simulator, p. 2). No 3GPP, DeepMIMO, COST 2100, or measured data is named anywhere.
q2_support: p. 5: "For testing, the Rician fading channel is used for the direct channel between the BS and users", after training with "Rayleigh fading for all channels".
q3_support: p. 1: "outperforms the classic DDPG and genetic algorithms in terms of EE"; p. 5: "we compare the Meta-DDPG with genetic algorithm, optimization-based, and exhaustive search methods". Only learned baseline is classic DDPG.
q4_support: p. 4: "Time-Complexity Analysis of Meta-DDPG" derives the order of complexity as an O(...) sum over the layer sizes of the actor, critic, and meta-critic networks.
q5_support: p. 4: "we use PyTorch 1.4.0", with no link; no code or data release is stated, and the channels are synthetic Rayleigh and Rician (p. 5).
notes: Area 3: learned beamforming and STAR-RIS configuration (p. 2-3); power splitting is an extra SWIPT variable. q3 rests on classic DDPG as the only learned baseline, which is also Meta-DDPG without the meta-critic loss (p. 4): reviewer to confirm it is not read as an ablation. q2 rests on Rayleigh training and Rician testing of the direct link only (p. 5). No frequency band or network sizes stated. Table I and Figs. 2-3 were read from page images.
